19                                                                            
        Pursuant to LCR 7(d)(1) and LCR 10(g), Plaintiff Recreational Equipment, Inc. (REI) and 
20                                                                            
   Defendant UKG, Inc., f/k/a The Ultimate Software Group, Inc. (UKG), by and through their 
21                                                                            
   attorneys of record, hereby submit this Stipulated Motion and [Proposed] Order to Extend the 
22                                                                            
   Deadline to File Initial Disclosures, Joint Status Report, and Related Deadlines by four weeks to 
23                                                                            
24  facilitate the Parties’ efforts to resolve this case via mediation, which is currently scheduled for 
25  April 8, 2021.                                                            
26                                                                            

27  STIPULATION AND ORDER TO EXTEND DEADLINE TO                               
   FILE INITIAL DISCLOSURES, JOINT STATUS REPORT                             
1       The Parties have met and conferred, and submit this Stipulated Motion in good faith. Good 
2  cause exists to grant the Parties’ request as set forth below.            
3                                                                            
                              DISCUSSION                                     
4                                                                            
        By its Order regarding Initial Scheduling Dates, the Court set the deadline for the Parties 
5                                                                            
   to complete a FRCP 26(f) Conference for March 18, 2021, and also established the deadline for 
6                                                                            
   Initial Disclosures for April 1, 2021, and a Combined Joint Status Report and Discovery Plan for 
7                                                                            
8  April 8, 2021. Dkt. 16.1 Prior to the Court’s Order, the Parties agreed to schedule a mediation in 
9  this case in order to resolve the dispute in lieu of trial. Mediation is scheduled to take place on 
10  April 8, 2021, and the Parties are diligently preparing to make the mediation successful.   
11                                                                            
        Pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 16(b)(4), case management deadlines established by the Court 
12                                                                            
   “may be modified only for good cause and with the judge’s consent.” Rule 16(b)’s “good cause” 
13                                                                            
   standard primarily considers the diligence of the party seeking the modification. Johnson v. 
14                                                                            
   Mammoth Recreations, Inc., 975 F.2d 604, 609 (9th Cir.1992). Here, the Parties are actively 
15                                                                            
16  preparing for mediation and agree that a short continuance of four weeks for each of the initial 
17  scheduling dates will best allow these efforts to continue.               
18                                                                            
        Should the mediation prove unsuccessful, the parties do not anticipate needing any further 
19                                                                            
   continuances beyond the current request. Accordingly, the Parties respectfully request that the 
20                                                                            
   Court approve this Stipulated Motion and agree to continue the deadline for the FRCP 26(f) 
21                                                                            
   conference, Initial Disclosures, and Combined Joint Status Report as follows: 
22                                                                            
23                                                                            
24                                                                            

25  1 The Court’s Order states that requests for extension of the initial scheduling deadlines should be made by telephone 
   to the Courtroom Deputy. Counsel for REI contacted the Court on March 10, 2021, and was directed to file a stipulated 
26  motion with the Parties’ request.

   FILE INITIAL DISCLOSURES, JOINT STATUS REPORT

    Combined Joint Status Report and Discovery Plan as  5/6/2021  4/8/2021   
5   Required by FCRP 26(f) and Local Civil Rule 26(f)                        
6

    PACIFICA LAW GROUP LLP        LEWIS BRISBOIS BISGAARD & SMITH LLP

        IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that this Stipulated Motion to continue the deadlines in

   the Initial Scheduling Order (Dkt. 19) is GRANTED. The new dates for the initial disclosure
